_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Bo é Jogadór {player_id} na Tri-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Símbolu bo é '{symbol}'.
Bo tira turnu pon símbolu bo na tabuleiru 5x5 para forma linha di kuatru.
Linha pódé sê horizontal, vertical ó diagonal.
Manda bo movimentu uzando formatu '[4]' para marka selula 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formatu di mudansa invalidu. Uza "[cell]" undi ki kel pilon é 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Númeru di pilon invalidu: {cell}. El debe sta entri 0 y {max_cell} .
